questions.question: 30 men can do a piece of work in 30 days working 8 hours in a day. How many men required completing half of the work in 15 days working 10 hours in a day?
questions.explanation:
Total work done by 30 men \(= \ 30 \times 30 \times 8\  = \ 7200\ units\)

Number of mens required to complete half of the work

\(= \ 7200 \times \frac{0.5}{15 \times 10} = 24\ \)

questions.question: A can do the work in 10 days and B can do the same work in 15 days. If B starts and A joins him after 5 days, then in how many days the work will be completed?
questions.explanation:
LCM(10,15)=30

The total work to be done is 30 units.

Work done by A in 1 day\(\  = \ \ \frac{30}{10} = \ 3\ unit\)

Work done by B in 1 day \(= \ \frac{30}{15}\  = \ 2\ unit\)

Let A and B work together for x days.

Work done by B in 5 days\(\  = \ \ 5 \times 2 = 10\ unit\)

As per question;

\(10 + 5x = 30\)

\( 5x = 20\)

\( x = 4\)

So, total time taken\(\  = \ 5 + 4\  = \ 9\ days\)

questions.question: If A is 120% efficient as B who is 80% efficient as C. If B and C assist A on every alternate days then they can complete the work in 12 days. Find the time taken by B and C together to complete the work?
questions.explanation:
Let efficiency of C be 10 units.

Then efficiency of B \(= \ 0.8 \times 10\  = \ 8\ units\)

Efficiency of A \(= \ 1.2 \times 8 = 9.6\ units\)

Work done by A and B in 1 day \(= \ 9.6 + 8 = 17.6\ units\)

Work done by A and C in 1 day \(= \ 9.6 + 10 = 19.6\ units\)

So, work done in 2 days \(= 17.6 + 19.6 = 37.2\ units\)

Work done in 12 day\(s\  = \ 37.2 \times 6\  = \ 223.2\ units\)

Time taken by B and C to complete the work;

\(= \ \frac{223.2}{18} = 12.4\  = \frac{62}{5}\text{\ days}\)

questions.question: 4 men and 6 women together or 8 men together can complete a piece of work in 40 days. 6 men and 6 women will complete the same work in how many days?
questions.explanation:
Let efficiency of men and women be m and w units respectively.

As per question;

\(4m + 6w = 8m\)

\(= > 4m = 6w\)

\(= > m:w = 3:2\)

Let \(m\  = \ 3k\) and \(w = 2k\ units\)

Total work \(= \ 8m \times 40 = 960k\ units\)

Now,

Time taken by 6 men and 6 women

\(= \frac{\ 960k}{6m + 6w} = \frac{960k}{30k} = 32\ days\)

questions.question: A and B together can finish a work in 12 hours, while B and C together can finish the same work in 9 hours. If B alone can finish 45% work in 16.2 hours, then at what time A and C together will finish the work?
questions.explanation:
\(\frac{1}{A}\  + \ \frac{1}{B}\  = \ \frac{1}{12}\) —--------(1)

\(\frac{1}{B}\  + \ \frac{1}{C}\  = \ \frac{1}{9}\) —--------(2)

Since, B alone can finish 45% work in 16.2 hours.

So, time taken by B alone to finish the whole work = \(16.2\  \times \ \frac{100}{45}\) = 36 hours

From equation (1):

\(\frac{1}{A}\  = \ \frac{1}{12}\  - \ \frac{1}{36}\  = \ \frac{3\  - \ 1}{36}\  = \ \frac{1}{18}\)

So, time taken by A alone to finish the work = 18 hours

From equation (2):

\(\frac{1}{C}\  = \ \frac{1}{9}\  - \ \frac{1}{36}\  = \ \frac{4\  - \ 1}{36}\  = \ \frac{1}{12}\)

So, time taken by C alone to finish the work = 12 hours

Part of work completed by A and C together in 1 hour = \(\frac{1}{18}\  + \ \frac{1}{12}\  = \frac{1}{7.2}\ \)

So, time taken by A and C together to finish the work = 7.2 hours

questions.question: S can do a piece of work in 20 days. T is 25% more efficient than S. The number of days taken by T to do the same piece of work is
questions.explanation:
Let work done by S in 1 day be 4 units.

So, work done by T in 1 day \(= \ 1.25 \times 4 = \ 5\ units\)

Total work done by S alone in 20 days \(= \ 20 \times 4\  = \ 80\ units\)

Time taken by T to complete the work together \(= \ \frac{80}{5} = 16\ days\)

questions.question: 5 men and 3 women can complete a work in 17 days .While 2 men and 4 women complete the same work in 34 days . Then what is the ratio of Men’s efficiency to women's efficiency ?
questions.explanation:
Given , 5 men or 7 women can complete the work in 48 days

We can say , 5 men = 7 women

=> the ratio of efficiency of man : woman = 7 : 5

Let the efficiency of man and woman be 7 units / day and 5 units /day respectively .

Then the total work = 7 X 5 X 48 = 1680 units

Thus, time taken by 5 men and 1 woman to complete the work will be :

Total efficiency of 5 men and 1 women

= 5 X 7 + 1 X 5

= 40 units/day

Total work = 1680 units

Hence , time taken will be

=Total work / efficiency [work done in 1 days ]

= 1680 / 40

= 42 days

questions.question: 3 men and 2 women earn Rs 2250 in 5 days. 5 men and 1 woman earn Rs 2400 in 6 days. In how many days will 5 men and 2 women earn Rs 3300.
questions.explanation:
Let work done by men and women in 1 day be m and w units respectively.

As per question;

\(5(3m + 2w) = 2250\)

\(= > 3m + 2w = 450–\ (1)\)

SImilarly, \(5m + w = 400–(2)\)

From (1) and (2); \(m\  = \ 50\ and\ w\  = 150\)

So, \(5m\  + 2w = 5(50) + 2(150) = 550\)

Number of days taken \(= \ \frac{3300}{550} = 6\ days\)

questions.question: A and B can finish work in 20 days. B and C in 30 days and C and A in 40 days. In how many days will A alone finish the job?
questions.explanation:
LCM ( 20,30,40) \(= \ 120\)

The total work to be done is 120 units.

Work done by A+B in 1 day\(\  = \ \frac{ 120}{20} = 6\ units\)

Work done by B+C in 1 day \(= \ \frac{ 120}{30} = 4\ units\ \)

Work done by A+C in 1 day \(= \ \frac{120}{40} = 3\ unit\)

Work done by A+B+C in 1 day = 6+4+32 = 6.5 units

Therefore;

Work done by A  in one day = 2.5 units

Total Work done by A alone is = 1202.5 = 48 days

questions.question: Varun and Karun can do a piece of work in 18 days and 27 days respectively. Karun starts the work and Varun joined him after some days. The total work is completed in 15 days from the beginning. After how many days did Varun joined with Karun?
questions.explanation:
Concept Used:
If a person takes x days to complete a work, the part of the work completed by him in 1 day = 1/x
Calculations:
Consider, Varun joined after 'x' days.
So, the work can be divided into two parts:
First, when Karun works alone for x days.
Secondly, when they work together for (15 - x) days. Hence, the total work becomes:
Karun's x days' work + (Varun's + Karun's) (15 - x)
days' work = 1
x27+ (15-x)(127+118)=12x54+ (15-x)(2+354)=12x+5×(15-x)=542x+75-5x=54-3x=54-75x=213=7
Hence, Varun joined with Karun after 7 days.

questions.question: Raghav alone and Pramod alone can complete a project respectively in 3 hours and 12 hours more than the time taken if both of them worked together. In how much time Pramod alone can complete the project?
questions.explanation:
Calculation:

Let Raghav and Pramod together can complete the project in x hours.

Time taken by Raghav alone to complete the project = (x + 3) hours

Time taken by Pramod alone to complete the project = (x + 12) hours

According to the question,

\(\frac{1}{x}\  = \ \frac{1}{x + 3}\  + \frac{1}{x + 12}\)

\(\frac{1}{x}\) = \(\frac{x + 12 + x + 3}{(x + 3)(x + 12)}\)

\(\frac{1}{x}\) = \(\frac{2x + 15}{(x + 3)(x + 12)}\)

x2 + 15x + 36 = 2x2 +15x

x2 = 36

x = 6

Time taken by Pramod alone to complete the project = 6 + 12 = 18 hours

Option ‘18’ is the correct answer.

Alternate Method:

Let the time taken by Raghav and Pramod together = x hours.
Then,
Raghav alone takes = x + 3 hours
Pramod alone takes = x + 12 hours
Work equation:
Work done in 1 hour = 1/x
So,
1/x = 1/(x + 3) + 1/(x + 12)
Take LCM of x(x + 3)(x + 12)
Now,
(x + 3)(x + 12) = x(x + 12) + x(x + 3)
Simplify:
x² + 15x + 36 = 2x² + 15x
Subtract x² + 15x from both sides →
x² = 36
x = 6
Step 4:
Pramod alone takes = x + 12 = 6 + 12 = 18 hours
Final Answer: Pramod alone can complete the project in 18 hours.

questions.question: A and B can complete the work in 20 days and 30 days respectively and after 5 days C joined with them. C is twice the efficiency of B. In how many days total work is completed?
questions.explanation:
A = 1/20
B = 1/30
C = 1/15
LCM of (20, 30, 15) = 60 units
A complete the one day work = 3 units
B complete the work in one day = 2 units
C complete the work in one day = 4 units
A and B works in first five days = 5 * (3 + 2) = 25 units
Remaining work = 60 – 25 = 35
A, B and C together can complete the remaining work in = 35/(3 + 2 + 4)
= 35/9 = 3(8/9) days
Total work time = 5 + 3 (8/9) = 8(8/9) days

questions.question: A and B can finish work in 20 days. B and C in 15 days and C and A in 30 days. In how many days will B alone finish the job?
questions.explanation:
LCM ( 20,15,30) \(= \ 60\)

The total work to be done is 60 units.

Work done by A+B in 1 day\(\  = \ \frac{ 60}{20} = 3\ units\)

Work done by B+C in 1 day \(= \ \frac{ 60}{15} = 4\ units\ \)

Work done by A+C in 1 day \(= \ \frac{ 60}{30} = 2\ unit\)

Work done by A+B+C in 1 day\(\  = \ \frac{3 + 4 + 2}{2} = \ 4.5\ units\)

Therefore;

Work done by B  in one day = 2.5 units

Total Work done by B alone is = 602.5 = 24 days

questions.question: A and B alone can do a piece of work in x and (x+10) days respectively and they work together and can finish the work in 9 (⅜) days. Then find the time taken by B to complete work ?
questions.explanation:
Time taken A and B to complete the work\(\  = \ 9(\frac{3}{8})\ days\)

\(= > \frac{1}{A} + \frac{1}{B} = \frac{8}{75}\)

\(= > \frac{1}{X} + \frac{1}{X + 10} = \frac{8}{75}\)

\(= > \frac{(2X + 10)}{(X(X + 10))} = \frac{8}{75}\)

\(= > 150X + 750 = 8X(X + 10)\)

\(= > 150X + 750 = 8X^{2} + 80X\)

\(= > 8X^{2} - 70X - 750 = 0\)

\(= > X = 15,\  - 6.25\)

Therefore, time taken by B\(= \ x + 10 = \ 25\ days\)

questions.question: 'N' number of men can complete a piece of work in 80 days. Had there been 15 men less, it would have taken 16 days more. Find the value of N?
questions.explanation:
Given:

number of men = N

Then N men do the work in 80 days.

By the given condition: Now (N-15) men do the work in (80+16) = 96 days

Calculation:

Thus, N×80 = (N-15)×96       →   {when we make the total work equal}

80N = 96N - 1440

16N = 1440

N = 90 men

Hence initially there were 90 men.

questions.question: If the ratio of time taken by A, B, and C to finish a work individually is 4:3:5. All three were paid collectively Rs 9400. What is the share of C?
questions.explanation:
The ratio of time taken by A, B, C are given as 4:3:5. 

Then ratio of their efficiencies are- ¼ : ⅓  : ⅕ = 15: 20: 12

Total share =47 unit

C’s share =12 unit

C’s share = 1247 x 9400 = 2400

questions.question: 4 men and 6 women together or 8 men together can complete a piece of work in 40 days. 6 men and 6 women will complete the same work in how many days?
questions.explanation:
Let efficiency of men and women be m and w units respectively.

As per question;

\(4m + 6w = 8m\)

\(= > 4m = 6w\)

\(= > m:w = 3:2\)

Let \(m\  = \ 3k\) and \(w = 2k\ units\)

Total work \(= \ 8m \times 40 = 960k\ units\)

Now,

Time taken by 6 men and 6 women

\(= \frac{\ 960k}{6m + 6w} = \frac{960k}{30k} = 32\ days\)

questions.question: Ayush takes 20% more time than Bunty and they both completes the work in 8211days. Find in how much time Ayush can do the half of the work.
questions.explanation:
Let Bunty takes X days to complete the whole work alone.
So, Ayush takes 1.20X to complete the whole work alone.

A.T.Q.

11.20X+1X=1190

On solving this we get,
X = 15 days
So, Ayush takes 1.50 × 15 = 18 days to complete whole work alone.
Ayush completes half the work in 18 ÷ 2 = 9 days.

questions.question: 9 women and 5 men can do work in 9 days. 8 women and 9 men can do the same work in 6 days. 5 women and 9 men can do the work in x days, find the value of x?
questions.explanation:
Let efficiency of man be m unit and women be w unit.

According to question;

Total work\(\  = \ (9w + 5m) \times 9–(1)\)

Total work\(\  = (8w + 9m) \times 6—(2)\)

\(= > (9w + 5m) \times 9 = (8w + 9m) \times 6\)

\(= > 81w + 45m = 48w + 54m\)

\(= > 33w = 9m\)

\(= > w = \frac{3}{11m}–(3)\)

Putting (3) in (1); we get

Total work\(\  = \ (\frac{738}{11})m\)

\(= > \frac{738}{11m} = (5w + 9m) \times x\)

\(= > \frac{738}{11m} = (\frac{15}{11m} + 9m)x\)

\(= > \frac{738}{11m} = \frac{114}{11x}\)

\(= > \frac{738}{114} = x\)

\(= > x = \frac{123}{19} = 6(\frac{9}{19})\ days\)

questions.question: X can do work in 5 days and Y in 10 days. If they work on it together for 2 days, then the fraction of the work that is left is:
questions.explanation:
LCM(5,10)\(= 10\)

The total work to be done is 10 units.

Work done by X in 1 day\(\  = \ \frac{10}{5}\  = \ 2\ unit\)

Work done by Y in 1 day\(\  = \ \frac{10}{10}\  = \ 1\ unit\)

Work done by(X+Y) in 2 day\(s = \ 2 \times 3 = 6\ unit\)

Work left \(= \ 10 - 6 = 4\ unit\)

Fraction of work left \(\  = \frac{4}{10} = \frac{2}{5}\ \)
